race.comment: Open race. A DIVA (6) can be a sharp improver second up. She raced wide without cover first up at Cranbourne behind a handy one and wasn't beaten all that far into seventh. Quickly to 1700m but that suits, her second up effort behind Terilee last campaign goes close to winning this with any luck. STAY HUMBLE (4) has been up a long time but continues to race very well, too tough on speed here last time out. He'll roll forward and take catching again. STUNG (5) was behind A DIVA at Cranbourne first up but should improve quickly up in trip, her 3yo form last time in is solid. DUBAI WATCH (9) is going okay and should take some holding out.
